rocketDecals.description: Website and Discord community to order and download custom Rocket League stickers
rocketDecals.fullDescription: Rocket Decals is a project combining a website and Discord community, allowing Rocket League players to order and download their own custom stickers, directly usable via BakkesMod and AlphaConsole. The project is run with an artist friend: I mainly handle site development, as well as communication and partnership outreach. We regularly collaborate with content creators and influencers with hundreds of thousands of subscribers, to offer unique designs and strengthen the community's visibility.

fluxParticulaire.description: Website to visualise particle flows between multiple browser windows in real time
fluxParticulaire.fullDescription: Flux Particulaires is a website that allows you to visualise particle flows between multiple browser windows in real time.

erlos.description: Shortcut manager mimicking an OS interface
erlos.fullDescription: ErlOS is a shortcut manager mimicking an OS interface, allowing you to create, edit and delete shortcuts. It also allows you to create charts, play Minesweeper, contains various customisation tools and more.

erplain.fullDescription: Erplain is an all-in-one management solution designed for small and medium-sized businesses: it centralises B2B sales, inventory management, purchasing, quotes, purchase orders and invoices. It enables real-time stock level monitoring, automates restocking and integrates with platforms such as Shopify, QuickBooks Online or Stripe.

supervision.fullDescription: As part of my work-study at Sercel, I had the opportunity to work on the Supervision project. Structures such as wind turbines or bridges are very costly structures that eventually become fragile, which is why it is important to ensure their integrity. Sercel's monitoring solution makes it possible to estimate the lifespan of a structure and view a wealth of information about it. This is made possible by the series-wired sensor solution (S-Morpho), monitoring calculation and the Supervision application, which provides access to many indicators in the form of dashboards.

lomet.fullDescription: LOMET is a work methodology modeller that allows it to be represented graphically. Project carried out as part of my internship at LIG.

erlinks.fullDescription: Erlinks is a personal link management site inspired by Linktree.

intemporal.fullDescription: As part of my training at IUT 2 Grenoble, I had the opportunity to work on the Intemporal project. This project was a watch auction site, allowing the sale and purchase of watches. We won a jury prize from the IUT Informatique de Grenoble for the quality of our prototype.
